en: A colorized panoramic postcard view of a historic European spa town nestled in a narrow valley surrounded by forested hills. The town is densely packed with multi‑story buildings, many with red roofs and ornate 19th‑century facades. A wooded hill rises steeply on the right. At the top left in red and black Gothic script appears a German caption identifying the scene as a view toward the Schlossberg and the Hirschensprung in Karlsbad.
